shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; else echo 'NO_ROUND_BRIEF'; fi
sed -n '1,300p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
rg -n \"beforeSession|afterSession|onError\" src test tests specs .lore/test-commands.yml package.json 2>/dev/null | head -240
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
sed -n '1,260p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,130p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
cat package.json
rg -n \"specs/.+#|spec anchor|@spec|validated by\" src scripts | head -160
rg --files scripts | rg 'spec-links|reanchor'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md
nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts | sed -n '1,55p'
nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '35,45p'
git diff --check
git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts
git status --short
git diff --check'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts && git commit -m "Handle beforeSession failures through lifecycle hooks" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count @{upstream}...HEAD'
